limitations: Long-side direction for BE-ME/OP/INV/Momentum/ST-Reversal/LT-Reversal is quoted from French's own f-f_5_factors_2x3 detail page (HML/RMW/CMA definitions) and each standalone factor file's own header text (Mom/ST_Rev/LT_Rev = High/Low minus the other side); direction for AC/BETA/ME/EP/CFP/DP follows standard textbook anomaly convention and was not independently re-verified against a French text page in this pass. No 2026-01-01+ observation was used in any computed statistic; the file's 'latest date' recorded in the manifest is metadata and does reach into 2026.
